assumptions: CONJECTURE: retaining five bounded public source variables and the sparse EC addition graph exposes exploitable structure that is destroyed by summation-polynomial elimination.
HEURISTIC: a multivariate lattice or hybrid sparse solver can exploit more than the generic box-volume boundary T_1*T_2*T_3*T_4*T_5 approximately p.
UNTESTED: all full-field coordinate and projective variables can be handled without recreating a D2-sized elimination object.
UNTESTED: the complete algebraic candidate list, registry rejections, and duplicate identifier decorations remain within the claimed completion bound.

NEGATIVE RESULT: the frozen explicitly materialized first-power tensor-box lattice has Theta(B^5) dimensions and fails the preprocessing gate; its determinant-volume heuristic has no positive recovery slack, so it is not an implementation candidate.
MODEL-BOUND: failure closes only the registered bounded-source circuit, shift schedule, and completion method.
TOY-EVIDENCE: the first census uses generated 8/10/12-bit curves and cannot establish an exponent.
falsification_conditions: The identifier projection of accepted decorated circuit solutions has a missing or extraneous witness for an identity, doubling, inverse, repeated-leaf, branch-pole, duplicate-fiber, or ordinary addition case.
No preregistered lattice determinant or solver-size argument has asymptotic slack beyond generic enumeration at B approximately p^(1/5).
A target schedule is selected from candidate support, planted witness indices are unblinded, or fallback is used on any attempted target.
The positive path constructs D2, D3, a target-indexed vector of size Omega(B^2), or an equivalent hidden compatibility table.
A complete certificate requires at least the exact D2+D3 online operation or traffic vector, or any supported target uses the charged fallback.
Candidate work or resident bytes fail the 0.8 continuation gates against exact D2+D3 or the same-map randomized source control on either seed at any registered size.
interpretation_limits: A development continuation pass is permission for a larger solver census, not an ECDLP exponent result.

A sub-B^2 attempted-target result is insufficient for a rho improvement; constant-yield five-term relation collection ultimately needs per-attempt B-slope below 1.5 or actual B-target batch slope below 2.5.
Any p-1-smooth or auxiliary-isogeny compositional factor base is reported as a separate family with its construction cost and field restrictions.
Generic Groebner speedups, unsupported lattice candidates, or supported-only targets cannot satisfy the hypothesis.
hypothesis.mechanism: Keep each factor leaf as a bounded public source root connected to its curve point by a rational-map equation, retain an exact polynomial graph of five EC additions, specialize only the public target ports, and solve the resulting sparse circuit with a dedicated bounded-root and certified sparse-completion method without materializing intermediate sum supports.

predictions.metric: complete attempted-target online operations versus exact D2+D3
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x on both seeds at every development size with zero fallback on supported targets

predictions.metric: candidate operations, live bytes, or solver nonzeros versus the same-map randomized source control
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x without support or witness loss

predictions.metric: target-specific resident state versus D2 x-orbit count
predictions.minimum_effect: strictly o(B^2) in the symbolic design and at most 0.8x in development

predictions.metric: eventual constant-yield B-target relation batch work
predictions.minimum_effect: upper fitted B-slope below 2.5, with a per-independent-attempt target of slope below 1.5

hypothesis.statement: At least one public bounded or composition-labeled prime-field factor base admits a complete five-leaf generalized-root decoder whose positive path avoids D2/D3 materialization and has a credible total relation-collection path below B^2.5 at B approximately n^(1/5).

test_boundary.implementation: No implementation until the exact addition-graph equivalence lemma, object-dimension ledger, lattice feasibility audit, literature review, and independent red-team review all pass.
instances: the six generated curves from DEV-OUTER-TRANSLATOR-001

parameters.null_policy: same public map, branch cardinalities, source-bound shapes, fibers, poles, and orientations with randomized accepted roots; if no nontrivial bound-matched null exists, use only the degree/nonzero/bound-matched generic circuit control
parameters.target_schedule: uniform targets from independent preregistered scalar seeds plus separately blinded planted controls, with exact hit/no-hit cardinalities and no fallback
